test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Which organization/ministry provides the Swachh Vayu Survekshan award?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swachh Vayu Survekshan** is an initiative by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** of India.
 
• It aims to rank cities based on their efforts to improve **air quality**, focusing on the implementation of clean air action plans under the **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)**.
 
• The survey promotes **awareness** and encourages cities to adopt sustainable practices to combat **air pollution**.
 
• The **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change** is responsible for the planning, promotion, coordination, and overseeing the implementation of environmental and forestry policies and programs in India.
 
• This ministry plays a crucial role in the conservation of the **environment**, including controlling **pollution**, managing **forests** and **wildlife**, and addressing **climate change**.
 
• The ministry works in collaboration with **state governments**, urban bodies, and other stakeholders to implement such initiatives effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**__

 __
 
• This ministry is primarily responsible for matters related to **public health**, **medical education**, and **family welfare programs**.
 
• It oversees initiatives such as the **National Health Mission (NHM)**, **Ayushman Bharat**, and various immunization programs.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**__
 __
 
• This ministry focuses on **urban development**, **housing**, and related infrastructure in urban areas.
 
• It is responsible for programs like **Smart Cities Mission**, **AMRUT (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation)**, and **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)**.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**__
 
 
• **NITI Aayog** (National Institution for Transforming India) is a policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• Its primary role is to provide strategic and technical advice to the **central** and **state governments**.
 
• It is involved in initiatives like **Aspirational Districts Programme** and **Atal Innovation Mission**.
